question: Does a second evidence context tell which P3-20 answer changes to keep? If the fixed 7B, given another Top-5, returns to its C1 answer, the P3-20 change is treated as unstable and C1 is kept.

l2_round.relation: a post-call acceptance gate of step_3_gates. L2 bge20_bm2520_ce_only failed its confirm adoption test (paired net -1 against route 1, 98/99), so it is used here only as the second context, not as a replacement for P3-20.

fixed: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct NF4 (rev a09a354) is not trained. Route 1 is unchanged up to its final answer; the gate only decides between route 1's P3-20 answer and C1.

gate.scope: items route 1 sends to P3-20 whose route-1 final answer differs from the C1 answer
gate.voter: the L2 setting bge20_bm2520_ce_only of configs/controller/l2_round_v1.json step_2_l2 (BGE top 20 plus BM25 top 20, GPU cross-encoder, top 5 by cross-encoder score), answered as P3-20 answers: the C1 answer when its Top-5 equals C1's Top-5 or when answer_rejection rejects the generated answer, else the stripped generated answer
gate.rule: keep C1 when normalize_standard(voter) == normalize_standard(C1) and normalize_standard(voter) != normalize_standard(route-1 answer); otherwise keep the route-1 answer
gate.cost: one extra candidate stage and at most one extra 7B generation per item in scope

sweep_evidence.status: in-sample exploration on the sweep 6,000 before registration
sweep_evidence.route_1: 978 changed of 3,013 routed items: fix 239, harm 140, net +99 against C1
sweep_evidence.gate: fix 208, harm 83, net +125 against C1 (+26 against route 1)
sweep_evidence.selection: one voter fixed in advance as the L2 choice; the rule was picked among three margins (agree minus keep-C1 >= -1, 0, 1), which give +99, +125 and +101. Votes from 4 or 17 contexts gave +129 and +135 and are not registered.

confirm.set: confirm 2,440 (its fourth, disclosed use: route-1 confirm, route-2 paired arm, L2 adoption, this gate)
confirm.inputs: stored route-1 confirm results, the L2 confirm candidates and generations, and the existing judge labels; no new GPU run or judge call
confirm.rule: direction check only: judge-assisted net of the gate against route 1 > 0 to proceed to Test; exact McNemar p is reported, not required
confirm.why: expected effect about +10 on 1,206 routed items with about 35 discordant answers is too small for p < 0.05

test.set: team Test 11,114 (a further disclosed exposure after the route-1 Test)
test.runs: L2 candidates and the voter answer only for Test items in gate scope (route-1 Test results); Test queries only, gold stays local
test.adoption: paired against route 1 on Test: judge-assisted net > 0 and exact McNemar p < 0.05
test.labels: gated answers are route-1 answers or C1 answers, both labelled in the route-1 Test archive; the RAG label wins on conflicts as before
test.report: also net against C1, team RAG and the team product

metric: judge-assisted correctness. Unchanged answers count zero.
